say:11:1521602007:0.source_cn: 出人意料的是，怪物仅仅是发出了一些威胁的声音，却没有直...

say:12:1521602008:0.text: Maybe there's still a shred of sanity left in him. You hesitate... Should you step closer and <style="highlight">try to talk</style>?

say:12:1521602008:0.female: Maybe there's still a shred of sanity left in him. You hesitate... Should you step closer and <style="highlight">try to talk</style>?

say:0:1521603001:0.male: Maybe we can talk to him... We have to try.
say:0:1521603001:0.female: Maybe we can talk to him... We have to try.

say:3:1521604002:0.text: Who... Who are you? What are you doing here?
say:3:1521604002:0.source_cn: 你……你是谁？在这里做什么？

say:5:1521604004:0.text: The monster stares at you and Gala for a long moment, then lowers its head and turns its attention back to the stones. It doesn't seem to understand a word.
say:5:1521604004:0.source_cn: 怪物盯着你和加拉看了半晌，又再次低下头，对着手中的石头...
say:5:1521604004:0.male: The monster stares at you and Gala for a long moment, then lowers its head and turns its attention back to the stones. It doesn't seem to understand a word.
say:5:1521604004:0.female: The monster stares at you and Gala for a long moment, then lowers its head and turns its attention back to the stones. It doesn't seem to understand a word.

say:6:1521604005:0.source_cn: 你在对这些石头做什么？

say:12:1521604011:0.text: Are all these stones your work?
say:12:1521604011:0.source_cn: 周围的石头，都是你的作品吗？

say:13:1521604012:0.text: The monster nods, then shakes its head just as fast, gesturing with its claws like it's trying to explain something.
say:13:1521604012:0.source_cn: 怪物胡乱地点了点头，又立刻摇头，手里不停地比划着什么。

say:0:1521605001:0.text: There seems to be <style="highlight">a piece of paper</style> over there. Maybe there's a clue there.

say:0:1521605001:0.female: There seems to be <style="highlight">a piece of paper</style> over there. Maybe there's a clue there.

say:0:1521606001:0.source_cn: 看起来是一个父亲写给离家儿子的信。但为什么没寄出去？
say:0:1521606001:0.male: It looks like a letter from a father to his son who left home. But why wasn't it sent?
say:0:1521606001:0.female: It looks like a letter from a father to his son who left home. But why wasn't it sent?

say:1:1521606002:0.text: Maybe there are more letters here. Let's look around.
say:1:1521606002:0.source_cn: 周围会不会有更多信？要不要找找看？
say:1:1521606002:0.male: Maybe there are more letters here. Let's look around.
say:1:1521606002:0.female: Maybe there are more letters here. Let's look around.

say:1:1521607001:0.text: A forgotten journal, its cover gnawed by time. Only brittle fragments cling to its spine, like memories refusing to fade.
say:1:1521607001:0.source_cn: 这似乎是谁丢掉的日记。残留的笔记本封皮早已被侵蚀，只剩...

say:2:1521607002:0.text: For some reason, you get the feeling this is tied to that letter you found earlier.
say:2:1521607002:0.source_cn: 莫名地，你隐约觉得它与之前找到的那封信有所联系。

say:2:1521607002:0.female: For some reason, you get the feeling this is tied to that letter you found earlier.

narration:0:1521609001:0.female: As magic surges through you, a memory flashes before your eyes...

say:6:1521609003:0.text: What's this, Father? My bag's already stuffed!
say:6:1521609003:0.source_cn: 老爹，你又拿了什么啊？你都给我塞了好多行李了！

say:7:1521609004:0.text: Oh, so now you're too good for your old man's help, huh?
say:7:1521609004:0.source_cn: 哟，瞧你那样，还嫌弃上你老爹我了？

say:8:1521609005:1.text: Listen up. This is a guardian statue.

say:9:1521609006:0.text: I pulled two all-nighters to make this. Keep it safe and don't lose it.
say:9:1521609006:0.source_cn: 你老爹我熬了两个通宵才做好，给我好好带上，不许弄丢了！

say:10:1521609007:1.text: Alright, alright. I won't lose it.
say:10:1521609007:1.source_cn: 好好好，我知道，肯定丢不了。

say:11:1521609008:1.text: It's time for me to be off.

say:12:1521609009:1.text: Aren't you gonna wait for your mother to come back? It'll be our last meal together for a while.
say:12:1521609009:1.source_cn: 不等你老娘回来吃顿饭吗？

say:13:1521609010:0.text: I can't. I'm hitching a ride on someone's carriage. If I don't make it on time, they'll leave.
say:13:1521609010:0.source_cn: 不了。我搭别人的马车，说好的就是这个时间，不能再拖了。

say:14:1521609011:0.text: I gotta go! I'll make sure to write to you and Mother.
say:14:1521609011:0.source_cn: 走了！我会记得给你们写信的！

say:17:1521609013:0.text: That little statue actually took you two days?
say:17:1521609013:0.source_cn: 就那么个小石像，居然还花了你两天时间？

say:18:1521609014:0.text: Your craft's slipping, Mason. Keep this up, and the shop'll go under.
say:18:1521609014:0.source_cn: 老石艺，你手艺是不是退步了啊？这么干下去，铺子迟早得黄吧。

say:19:1521609015:0.text: Come on, it's a gift for my boy. A little extra care won't wreck the schedule.
say:19:1521609015:0.source_cn: 那不是送给我儿子的吗，多花点时间怎么了，又不会耽误工期。

say:20:1521609016:0.text: See that huge rock over there? Someone actually commissioned me to carve a fountain out of it. Now that's a big job!
say:20:1521609016:0.source_cn: 喏，看到那边的大石头了吗？这次人家找我订了一个喷泉，这...

narration:22:1521609017:0.text: The echoing fragments of memory fade here. Whatever whispers pass between them now, you won't catch another word.

say:0:1521618001:0.female: Someone is fixing something... He should be the one in front.

say:3:1521620002:0.source_cn: 你们是谁？找我有什么事？

say:4:1521620003:0.text: We found your father's letter and his carving knife.
say:4:1521620003:0.source_cn: 我们找到了你阿爹的信。唔，还有刻刀。

His carving knife?
No way! My old man would never hand his knife to anyone!
say:5:1521620004:0.source_cn: 刻刀？！\n怎么可能，我老爹不可能把他的刻刀交给任何人！

choice_prompt:6:1521620004.text:
His carving knife?
No way! My old man would never hand his knife to anyone!
choice_prompt:6:1521620004.source_cn: 刻刀？！\n怎么可能，我老爹不可能把他的刻刀交给任何人！

say:7:1521620005:0.text: Tuttleton has been destroyed... No, this can't be...
say:7:1521620005:0.source_cn: 图塔镇毁灭了……这、这不可能！

say:8:1521620006:0.text: And my mother and father... They...
say:8:1521620006:0.source_cn: 还有我老爹和老娘……他们……

say:9:1521620007:0.text: You'll understand after you read the letter.
say:9:1521620007:0.source_cn: 你看了信以后，就会明白的。

say:10:1521620008:0.text: Warner's hands tremble as he takes the letter. A long silence passes... then his eyes well up with tears.
say:10:1521620008:0.source_cn: 维尔纳颤抖地接过信。好半晌的沉默之后，他的眼里已盛满泪水。

say:11:1521620009:0.text: My father... Where is he? I need to find him...
say:11:1521620009:0.source_cn: 我老爹……他，他在哪？我必须去找他……

say:12:1521620010:0.text: He's been turned into a monster. He isn't the man you knew.
say:12:1521620010:0.source_cn: 他已经畸变成怪物，不是你认识的那个人了。

say:13:1521620011:0.text: No matter what he's become, he's still my father. Please take me to him.
say:13:1521620011:0.source_cn: 不管他变成什么样，他都是我老爹！求求你们，带我去吧！

say:14:1521620012:0.text: I haven't been back in years... He always wrote letters telling me to visit, but I was always busy...
say:14:1521620012:0.source_cn: 我已经好几年没有回去了……他总是写信，但我总是忙……

say:15:1521620013:0.source_cn: 我……我不能连他最后一面也不见……！

say:16:1521620014:0.text: Tuttleton is too dangerous for you right now.
say:16:1521620014:0.source_cn: 但是，图塔镇的黑暗对你来说太危险了。

choice_prompt:17:1521620014.text: Tuttleton is too dangerous for you right now.
choice_prompt:17:1521620014.source_cn: 但是，图塔镇的黑暗对你来说太危险了。

say:18:1521620015:0.text: Yes! I'll do anything if you can take me to him...
say:18:1521620015:0.source_cn: 不管什么方法，只要能带我去见他就行……

say:20:1521620017:0.text: Warner pleads with you, so you cast a protective spell over him.
say:20:1521620017:0.source_cn: 在维尔纳的恳求下，你为他施加了一个保护魔法。
say:20:1521620017:0.male: Warner pleads with you, so you cast a protective spell over him.
say:20:1521620017:0.female: Warner pleads with you, so you cast a protective spell over him.

say:21:1521620018:0.text: I guess this should be okay.

say:22:1521620019:0.text: Stick close to us. It's time to <style="highlight">return to Tuttleton</style>.

choice:17:0:1.text: We can protect him with magic.
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 我们可以用魔法保护他
choice:17:0:1.male: We can protect him with magic.
choice:17:0:1.female: We can protect him with magic.

say:0:1521621001:0.text: Let's return to Tuttleton and find Warner's father.
say:0:1521621001:0.source_cn: 走吧，回图塔镇找维尔纳的父亲。
say:0:1521621001:0.male: Let's return to Tuttleton and find Warner's father.
say:0:1521621001:0.female: Let's return to Tuttleton and find Warner's father.

say:3:1521622002:0.text: I can't believe Tuttleton's become like this...
say:3:1521622002:0.source_cn: 图塔镇……居然变成了这样……

say:4:1521622003:0.text:
Why...?
God... why would you do this to your own people?!
say:4:1521622003:0.source_cn: 为什么……为什么……\n神啊，您为什么要这样对待您的信...

say:5:1521622004:0.text: My parents, my home... all I knew... gone...
say:5:1521622004:0.source_cn: 我老爹老娘……我的家……我的朋友们……全都没了！！

say:6:1521622005:0.text: Warner stares at the ruins of Tuttleton, his face buried in his hands as he sobs.
say:6:1521622005:0.source_cn: 维尔纳面对着图塔镇的废墟，掩面痛哭起来。

say:7:1521622006:0.text: It takes him a long moment before he finally gathers himself, pushing upright with a slow, weary resolve.
say:7:1521622006:0.source_cn: 好一阵子之后，他才重新直起身来。

say:8:1521622007:0.text: My father... Where is he? I have to go see him...
say:8:1521622007:0.source_cn: 我老爹……他在哪？我要去见他……

narration:0:1521626001:1.text: After what feels like forever, Warner and the creature that is his father finally finish the guardian statue together.

narration:1:1521626002:1.text: As Warner holds up the statue, the creature's lips twist into something like a smile.

say:4:1521627003:0.text: Don't worry... the pain will be over soon.
say:4:1521627003:0.source_cn: 你不用担心了，马上就不会再痛苦了……

say:6:1521627004:0.text: Can you two please help my father...? Let him <style="highlight">rest in peace</style>...
say:6:1521627004:0.source_cn: 两位魔法师，请你们帮帮我老爹……<style=high...

choice_prompt:7:1521627004.text: Can you two please help my father...? Let him <style="highlight">rest in peace</style>...
choice_prompt:7:1521627004.source_cn: 两位魔法师，请你们帮帮我老爹……<style=highlight>让他安息</style>吧。

say:8:1521627005:0.text: Honestly, when I saw that letter... I'd already braced myself for the truth... that he was gone.
say:8:1521627005:0.source_cn: 说实话，看到那封信的时候……我就做好了准备，接受他已经...

say:9:1521627006:0.text: I never imagined... this. His body... twisted and broken. He can't talk... He can't even stand.
say:9:1521627006:0.source_cn: 我从来没想过他会是这样。身体扭曲成这样，站也站不起来，...

say:10:1521627007:0.text: He was always a proud man... This wretched form mocks everything he stood for. He would've chosen the pyre over this.
say:10:1521627007:0.source_cn: 他那么固执……他绝对不想受这样的折磨。

say:11:1521627008:0.text: So please... I'm begging you. Help him. <style="highlight">Free him from this agony...</style>

choice_prompt:12:1521627008.text: So please... I'm begging you. Help him. <style="highlight">Free him from this agony...</style>
choice_prompt:12:1521627008.source_cn: 所以……我求你们帮帮他，<style=highlight>帮他脱离痛苦</style>……

say:14:1521627010:0.source_cn: 老爹，一切都会好起来的……

choice:7:1:2.text: Do you even know what you're asking?
choice:7:1:2.male: Do you even know what you're asking?
choice:7:1:2.female: Do you even know what you're asking?

say:1:1521630001:0.text: You don't have to suffer anymore, Father...
say:1:1521630001:0.source_cn: 你总算不用再受苦了，老爹……

say:2:1521630002:0.text:
I'll carve you a tombstone.
The biggest, finest one I can make... using everything you taught me.
say:2:1521630002:0.source_cn: 我会为你立一块墓碑。\n用我从你那里学到的手艺，亲手为...

say:3:1521630003:0.text: My friends, could you help me find a <style="highlight">big stone</style>? Everything around here's been eaten away. Nothing's good enough for this.
say:3:1521630003:0.source_cn: 两位魔法师，可以麻烦你们帮我找一块<style=hig...

choice_prompt:4:1521630003.text: My friends, could you help me find a <style="highlight">big stone</style>? Everything around here's been eaten away. Nothing's good enough for this.
choice_prompt:4:1521630003.source_cn: 两位魔法师，可以麻烦你们帮我找一块<style=highlight>大点的石头</style>吗？这附近的石头都被腐蚀了，没有合适的能用……

say:5:1521630004:0.text:
Thank you.
I'll stay here and wait for you two to come back...
say:5:1521630004:0.source_cn: 谢谢。\n我会待在这里等你们回来……
say:5:1521630004:0.male:
Thank you.
I'll stay here and wait for you two to come back...
say:5:1521630004:0.female:
Thank you.
I'll stay here and wait for you two to come back...

say:0:1521631001:0.text: This rock should be big enough for a tombstone.
say:0:1521631001:0.source_cn: 这块石头的大小应该足够做墓碑了，就它吧。
say:0:1521631001:0.male: This rock should be big enough for a tombstone.
say:0:1521631001:0.female: This rock should be big enough for a tombstone.

say:1:1521632001:0.text: Thanks for helping me find this stone. It's perfect for my father's grave.
say:1:1521632001:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们帮我找的石头。它很适合用来做墓碑。

say:2:1521632002:0.text: Please wait with me while I work... I'll be done soon.
say:2:1521632002:0.source_cn: 请等我一会……我很快就能做完。

narration:4:1521632003:0.text: With slow, deliberate strikes, Warner silently carves into the rock. Each tap of his tool shapes the cold stone into a grave marker.
narration:4:1521632003:0.source_cn: 维尔纳沉默地在石头上敲敲打打，将它打磨成墓碑的形状。

narration:5:1521632004:0.text: Finally, he carves the name "Gregory" into the tombstone and sets it upright where the creature fell.
narration:5:1521632004:0.source_cn: 最后，他在墓碑上刻下了“格雷格”这个名字，将它竖立在怪...

say:6:1521632005:0.text: Gregory was my father's first name.
say:6:1521632005:0.source_cn: 格雷格……这是我父亲的名字。

say:7:1521632006:0.text: Our family's been the stonemasons of Tuttleton for generations. We've carved everything... from temple statues and religious ornaments down to little stone charms for kids to wear.
say:7:1521632006:0.source_cn: 我们家族世代都是图塔镇的石匠。大到教堂和各类祭祀的神像...

say:8:1521632007:0.text: Mason is our family name. That's why people in town used to call my father "Old Mason".
say:8:1521632007:0.source_cn: “石艺”是我们家族的姓氏。镇上的人也一直管我老爹叫“老...

say:9:1521632008:0.text: His real name, Gregory, seemed to have been forgotten long ago...
say:9:1521632008:0.source_cn: 真正属于他自己的名字——格雷格，好像早就被人遗忘了……

choice_prompt:10:1521632008.text: His real name, Gregory, seemed to have been forgotten long ago...
choice_prompt:10:1521632008.source_cn: 真正属于他自己的名字——格雷格，好像早就被人遗忘了……

say:11:1521632009:0.text: Yes, Gregory will remain here, but Old Mason...
say:11:1521632009:0.source_cn: 格雷格会留在这里……但老石艺还不能。

say:12:1521632011:0.text: I used to hate it when people called him "Old Mason". It sounded so plain and rough, like an unpolished rock.
say:12:1521632011:0.source_cn: 我曾经很抵触“老石艺”这个名字。我嫌弃它一点也不好听，...

say:13:1521632012:0.text: But just now, watching my father carve into those stones, seeing all those scratches... I suddenly understood something.
say:13:1521632012:0.source_cn: 但刚刚，我看着老爹雕石头地样子，看着那些被划得乱七八糟...

say:14:1521632013:0.text: He was proud of what people called him.
say:14:1521632013:0.source_cn: 他以这个名字为傲……不是吗？

say:15:1521632014:0.text: So, I'll carry on the name "Old Mason". I'll make my work spread far and wide so that wherever it's known, his memory lives on.
say:15:1521632014:0.source_cn: 所以，我会继承“老石艺”这个名字。这样，如果有更多人知...

say:16:1521632015:0.text: Everyone will know that my father was the best stonemason in the world.
say:16:1521632015:0.source_cn: 我的老爹……他是世界上最好的石匠。

choice:10:0:1.text: Now this name will be remembered.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 现在这个名字会留在这里
choice:10:0:1.male: Now this name will be remembered.
choice:10:0:1.female: Now this name will be remembered.

choice:10:1:2.text: Will you use your family name now?
choice:10:1:2.male: Will you use your family name now?
choice:10:1:2.female: Will you use your family name now?

cinematic_dialogue:2:1521625002:.text: Let's finish this one together, Father
cinematic_dialogue:2:1521625002:.source_cn: 老爹，我陪你一起完成它

say:7:1521624002:0.text: Are you carving a guardian statue?
say:7:1521624002:0.source_cn: 老爹，你是在雕守护像吗？

say:8:1521624003:0.text: It's been years… I haven't been home in ages. Why are you still trying to make these statues?
say:8:1521624003:0.source_cn: 都过去这么久了，我离开家都好几年了……为什么还要雕守护像？

say:10:1521624005:0.text: I'm here, Father. I'm your son.

say:11:1521624006:0.text: ... Let me help you complete this statue.
say:11:1521624006:0.source_cn: 老爹……我陪你一起完成这座守护像。

cinematic_dialogue:13:1521625002:.text: Let's finish this one together, Father
cinematic_dialogue:13:1521625002:.source_cn: 老爹，我陪你一起完成它
